props.title: What Is Foot Reflexology and How Does It Work?
props.text: Foot reflexology is a traditional treatment that applies controlled pressure to reflex points on the feet, which reflexology holds are linked to other parts of the body. It is relaxing, and it eases tired feet after travel, long walks or a busy day.
props.feature1Text: Uses targeted pressure on specific areas of the feet rather than general massage strokes.
props.feature2Text: Encourages a calming effect that many guests experience beyond the feet themselves.

props.title: Choose the Session That Fits You

items.question: Is foot reflexology the same as a foot massage?
items.answer: Not exactly. At Spa Bali Moon, foot massage focuses on relaxing muscles and relieving soreness, while foot reflexology applies thumb and finger pressure to specific reflex points on the feet in a set sequence.

items.question: Does foot reflexology hurt?
items.answer: Most guests find foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon comfortable. Some reflex points may feel more sensitive than others, but your therapist always adjusts the pressure to your comfort and keeps a steady rhythm. Each session begins with gentle warm-up techniques and ends with relaxing finishing movements. Tell your therapist if anything feels too strong.

items.question: Is foot reflexology good after a day of walking around Bali?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon after sightseeing, shopping, hiking, or spending long hours on their feet. A 30-minute session suits tired feet when you are short on time, while 1 hour gives the full sequence at a relaxed pace.

items.question: Can I combine foot reflexology with another treatment?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon, guests often pair foot reflexology with a full-body massage, back massage or facial. One of our packages adds 30 minutes of reflexology to a 1-hour hot stone massage and a 1-hour cream bath.

items.question: Can I have foot reflexology at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything foot reflexology needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: How much does foot reflexology cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: Foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 99.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 169.000 for 1 hour and IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours per person. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or cash, and book on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm daily.

items.question: How long does a foot reflexology session take?
items.answer: Foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 30 minutes (IDR 99.000), 1 hour (IDR 169.000) or 1.5 hours (IDR 239.000) per person.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my foot reflexology?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your foot reflexology on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
